lines.text: Go on. Ribs, neck, under the arm.
Nothing. And it is not that you are doing it wrong.
Every time you move, your brain sends the order to your muscles, and a copy of that order somewhere else.
The copy is used to work out, in advance, exactly what you are about to feel.
What reaches you is only the difference.
Everything you did not see coming.
Your own hand is completely predicted. There is nothing left of it to feel.
Somebody else's hand is not predicted at all.
So in one experiment, they put a delay in the middle. A fifth of a second.
Same hand, same stroke. But now the prediction lands early, and the touch arrives on ground that is already clear.
You are not feeling the world. You are feeling the part of it your brain got wrong.
